claims: October 9, 2026 closing capital stack and XRP holdings.
$214.05m advance private-placement cash; $10.5m delayed private-placement cash; approximately $48m SPAC trust proceeds; approximately $272.6m gross cash at close before expenses.
Approximately $214.1m advance cash used to purchase 84,365,876 XRP; venue, counterparty and execution timestamps not disclosed.
Approximately 388,910,554 XRP contributed in kind; approximately 473m total XRP held at close.
$30m 4% PIK convertible senior notes issued and paid October 12, 2026; $30m proceeds before expenses.
Cantor equity line up to 5,218,935 shares and approximately $76.8m potential gross proceeds; zero proceeds received as of prospectus date; $521,893.50 commitment fee.
Company says it does not actively trade XRP on digital asset markets.
BitGo is custodian; Coinbase is the selected principal market for accounting valuation.
As of March 31, 2025, approximately 90% of USDC reserves were held in the Circle Reserve Fund managed by BlackRock and custodied by BNY; the remainder was cash distributed across banks.

The Circle Reserve Fund is a Rule 2a-7 government money market fund holding short-dated U.S. Treasuries, overnight Treasury repos and cash; it is not FDIC-insured or guaranteed by a government agency.
Circle's S-1/A says Coinbase has a minority equity stake and a USDC distribution/revenue-sharing relationship.
Coinbase-held USDC was 20% of circulation at 2024-12-31, 25% at 2025-03-31 and 21% at 2025-06-30; historical, not current.
Circle explicitly says USDC minted/redeemed do not represent the amount acquired or redeemed by end users.
SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank announced a combined $50m investment in Circle's IPO; $25m each.
SBI Group announced participation in Circle's ARC token presale; SBI-specific amount not disclosed.
Arc mainnet launched with a permissioned validator set; USDC is gas; SBI Group is a founding validator; Coinbase is listed as an exchange provider, not a validator in this announcement.
USDC is native on XRPL mainnet; Circle Mint and APIs support it; no bridging is required.
RLUSD launched in Japan through SBI VC Trade following JFSA approval under Japan's Payment Services Act.
SBI Group held 60% of SBI Ripple Asia voting rights as of March 31, 2026.
SBI Ripple Asia states it does not handle XRP; it describes RippleNet/fintech solutions.
Ripple describes the ODL service with SBI Remit, Coins.ph and SBI VC Trade as commercialized; current corridor volumes are not disclosed.
Japan-to-Philippines ODL launch used XRP as a bridge asset through SBI Remit, Coins.ph and SBI VC Trade.
XRP-based remittance routes were announced for bank-account payouts in the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia.
